title: The False Alarm Land Deal
hook: Why are you crying like the world has ended?!

characters.name: Chidi
characters.description: Sitting on sofa in a singlet, clutching an envelope, crying uncontrollably.

characters.name: Emeka
characters.description: Chidi's loyal, deeply empathetic childhood friend.

scenes.speaker: Emeka
scenes.dialogue: Chidi! Wetin happen? Why you dey cry like person wey world crash on top him head?!
scenes.caption_text: Emeka rushes into the parlour alarmed
scenes.sfx: Muffled crying with gentle domestic parlour ambiance
scenes.text: Emeka enters the parlour finding Chidi weeping into his palms.

scenes.speaker: Chidi
scenes.dialogue: Emeka... life is wicked! Just look at this letter from the general hospital!
scenes.caption_text: Chidi waves a crumpled clinic letter
scenes.text: Chidi points with shaking hands at a crumpled hospital diagnostic envelope on the table.

scenes.speaker: Emeka
scenes.dialogue: God forbid! Don't tell me Mama's illness has reached the final stage!
scenes.caption_text: Emeka gasps and holds his chest
scenes.image_keyword: man with hand on chest in shock
scenes.text: Emeka clasps his chest in utter panic fearing the worst for Chidi's mother.

scenes.speaker: Chidi
scenes.dialogue: The doctor called me inside office this morning... he said the laboratory test came out!
scenes.caption_text: Chidi sobs loudly into his shirt
scenes.text: Chidi wipes his tear-stained face with the hem of his faded singlet.

scenes.speaker: Emeka
scenes.dialogue: Calm down my brother! No matter how bad the diagnosis is, we go survive am together!
scenes.caption_text: Emeka kneels beside Chidi on the rug
scenes.text: Emeka kneels directly beside the sofa, gripping Chidi's shoulders reassuringly.

scenes.speaker: Chidi
scenes.dialogue: You don't understand, Emeka... the matter pass my power! Everything scatter completely!
scenes.caption_text: Chidi buries his face in his palms
scenes.text: Chidi rocks back and forth on the couch shaking his head in misery.

scenes.speaker: Emeka
scenes.dialogue: Listen to me! If Mama needs urgent surgery abroad, I go sell my Toyota Corolla today!
scenes.caption_text: Emeka offers his car without hesitation
scenes.text: Emeka looks directly into Chidi's eyes, offering supreme personal sacrifice.

scenes.speaker: Chidi
scenes.dialogue: Emeka, your car money cannot solve this disaster wey enter my hand now!
scenes.text: Chidi ignores the generosity, staring into space with profound dread.

scenes.speaker: Emeka
scenes.dialogue: Then I will sell my shop in Alaba! Even my flat-screen TV and generator, take everything!
scenes.text: Emeka passionately raises both hands, completely dedicated to saving his friend's family.

scenes.speaker: Emeka
scenes.dialogue: So talk to me! What did the Chief Doctor say about Mama's remaining days?!
scenes.caption_text: Emeka urgently demands the medical truth
scenes.text: Emeka grabs the envelope firmly to inspect the dreaded doctor's report.

scenes.speaker: Chidi
scenes.dialogue: The doctor said it was a computer error! Mama is hundred percent healthy!
scenes.text: Chidi sniffs loudly and reveals the test was completely negative.

scenes.speaker: Emeka
scenes.dialogue: Wait... Mama is completely fine?! Then why the hell are you crying like a madman?!
scenes.text: Emeka blinks in disbelief, completely stunned that good news produced intense sorrow.

scenes.speaker: Chidi
scenes.dialogue: Because last week when doctor said she had two days left...
scenes.text: Chidi looks around nervously as his tears turn into sheer panic.

scenes.speaker: Chidi
scenes.dialogue: I already sold her two plots of land in Lekki to Alhaji for half price without her knowing!
scenes.text: Emeka drops the letter as Chidi buries his face in regretful greed.

scenes.speaker: Emeka
scenes.dialogue: Yeee! So you don inherit your living mother! Police will not even save you today!
scenes.caption_text: Emeka backs away slowly in horror
scenes.sfx: Iconic Nigerian laughing meme sound effect outro
scenes.image_keyword: friend running away laughing meme pose
scenes.text: Emeka grabs his shoes and sprints out of the parlour while the laughing meme track blares.

caption: When empathy meets pure Lagos greed! Emeka was ready to sell his generator not knowing Chidi had already sold Mama's future. 😭😂
